title: Max the Dog Saves the Day

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who has a wet black nose, and a waggy tail?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who says: woof, woof? Can you guess?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's... a dog!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Woof! Hello! I'm Max the puppy!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Max! I'm Super Bobo! Do you want to come to our picnic?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Yes, please! I love picnics! Woof!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does a dog say?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Woof! Woof!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you bark like Max? Your turn!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Woof! Woof!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Dogs make lots of sounds! A happy dog says: woof! A tiny puppy says: yip, yip!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Yip, yip! Your turn!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's learn three dog facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact one. A dog has a super nose! It can smell much, much better than you and me.

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Sniff, sniff! I smell... sandwiches!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact two. When a dog wags its tail fast and wiggly, it is often happy!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Look at my tail! Wag, wag, wag! I'm happy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact three. Baby puppies are born with their eyes closed! They open them when they are about two weeks old.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Eyes closed? Wow! Tiny sleepy puppies!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: I can do tricks! Watch me! I can sit!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: I can give a paw!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: And I can spin around! Wheee!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you spin around like Max? Your turn!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Everyone sat down for the picnic. Bella the bunny counted her friends.

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Wait... where is Kiki? Kiki the kitten isn't here!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Everyone looked around. Kiki was missing! Bella felt worried.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who can help find Kiki? Who has a super nose?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Me! My nose can help! Sniff, sniff!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Max sniffed the grass. Kiki went this way! Past the flowers...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Max saw a ball! But he did not stop to play. Finding Kiki was more important!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sniff with Max! Sniff, sniff, sniff!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Past the little pond...

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Sniff... sniff... ACHOO! A flower tickled my nose! Back to the trail!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: All the way to... a big hollow log!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Kiki? Are you in there?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And there was Kiki! She was playing hide and seek, and she fell asleep!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Kiki! We found you! Max found you!

vo.speaker: kiki
vo.text: Yawn... Hi, Max! Did I win hide and seek?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ha ha! Yes, you did, Kiki! But we missed you!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Kiki yawned a big yawn, and gave Max a hug.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Max, you saved the day! Hooray for Max!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Woof! Thank you, friends! Helping is fun!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Friends look out for each other. And Max used his super nose to help!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: And next time, we play hide and seek all together, and we stay close!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Remember, friends: when you play outside, always stay close to your grown-up!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then everybody ate the picnic together. Even Max got a doggy treat!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Yum! Picnics are better with friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does a dog say?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Woof! Woof!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does a fast, wiggly tail often mean?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The dog is happy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How did Max find Kiki?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: With my super nose! Sniff, sniff!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where was Kiki hiding?

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: In a big hollow log!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How are baby puppies born? With their eyes...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Closed! Sleepy little puppies!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Say it with Max!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Sniff, sniff!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Wag, wag!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Max saves the day!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Sniff, sniff! Wag, wag! Max saves the day!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Woof, woof!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time!
